text:
Istcroft Traders quotes 100 per unit, delivers in 1 days, and holds a rating of 1 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Selhurst Cooperative quotes 25 per unit, delivers in 6 days, and holds a rating of 2 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Nevley Works quotes 60 per unit, delivers in 11 days, and holds a rating of 4 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Nevby Works quotes 120 per unit, delivers in 3 days, and holds a rating of 8 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Which supplier quotes at most 130 per unit, delivers within 9 days and is rated at least 8 out of 10?
